description: This file defines the 'Properties' class responsible for reading and processing property data from XML within the PhpSpreadsheet library's XLSX reader component. It handles core, extended, and custom properties in an Excel file.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Handles extraction and parsing of various property data (core, extended, custom) from XML strings within the XLSX reading process.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Properties object with security scanner and document properties dependencies.

methods.name: nullOrSimple
methods.description: Returns the SimpleXMLElement if the object is an instance of it; otherwise, returns null.

methods.name: extractPropertyData
methods.description: Processes XML string data, scans it for security, and loads it into a SimpleXMLElement for further parsing.

methods.name: readCoreProperties
methods.description: Parses core properties XML and sets the corresponding document properties.

methods.name: readExtendedProperties
methods.description: Parses extended properties such as Company, Manager, HyperlinkBase from XML and sets them in document properties.

methods.name: readCustomProperties
methods.description: Iterates over custom property XML nodes, extracts attributes, and sets custom properties with appropriate types.

methods.name: getArrayItem
methods.description: Helper method to safely retrieve an item from an array or null.
